name: dark-factory
description: Curie's default dark factory agent: one labelled GitHub issue in, one reviewed pull request or one stated reason out. A single agent reads the issue through a read-only GitHub MCP server, pins acceptance criteria, plans, writes a failing test where feasible, implements, runs the repository's own checks, reviews its diff against every criterion, and publishes through Curie's built-in approval-gated publication tool within the 1800 second execution bound.
